wishful.line: From any kind of wishful prayer
stanza: Sleep paralysis, I sworn I could’ve felt you there
And I almost could've kissed your hair
From any kind of wishful prayer

wishful.linePrev: The first time you ever saw me cry
stanza: I miss your tanned skin, your sweet smile
So good to me, so right
And how you held me in your arms that September night
The first time you ever saw me cry
But if we loved again, I swear I'd love you right
I'd go back in time and change it, but I can't
So, if the chain is on your door, I understand
